observed_failure_mode: Portfolio applications directly consume legacy platform integration credits for inference, uploads, messaging, image generation and extraction.
cutover_strategy: Replace application imports of legacy Core integrations with systemia/core/core-client.js or an app-local equivalent generated from that contract.
Route provider-backed operations through explicitly configured Systemia adapters. No application may call the legacy provider directly.
Keep file persistence and basic text/JSON/CSV extraction inside the Evercraft runtime where possible.
Require parity proof per application before disabling its legacy integration path.
